state.definitions: Columns start at 1 on the left. Holes are empty cells below a filled cell. Heights and holes are measured AFTER completed rows disappear. Each option is a legal rotate, shift, then hard-drop placement.

placement.instructions: Choose the Tetris placement that best keeps the game alive and clears rows. Avoid creating buried holes: they are very difficult to repair. Prefer more completed rows among placements with similarly few holes, then a low, compact, smooth stack. Compare the numeric outcomes in each option. All options are legal. There is no hold. Return the placement to actually execute.
